concepts.title: A place for possibility
concepts.story: Desegnos starts with a place on the canvas. An open architectural D creates a space to enter and shape, giving the product a spatial identity rather than a conventional editor badge.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Desegnos identity exploration.
Context: Desegnos is a visual website editor. People place descriptions directly on a canvas; the software turns those intentions into a working page. Product name is exactly "Desegnos", spelled D-e-s-e-g-n-o-s.
Deliverable: one polished landscape presentation split into two equal large panels. Left plain light background with dark logo; right plain dark background with the identical logo reversed to light. Each panel shows a large standalone capital D mark above the full wordmark "Desegnos". The SAME D mark forms the initial letter of the full wordmark, with optically adjusted scale. No extra icon next to another normal D. Both panels must have precisely the same geometry and layout; only foreground and background reverse. Generous clear margins. Only text is "Desegnos". All work should be flat graphic design with crisp vector-like edges, no photorealism or objects.
Nonnegotiable: This must depart radically from a generic bold sans-serif D. No thick closed geometric bowl with a little notch, no speech bubble, no cursor cutout, no outline-to-solid transition, no sports swoosh, no stock app glyph. The D must remain legible as D. No gradients, shadows, embossed effects, texture or mockup objects. Inversion must preserve every stroke and gap. Realistic brand-designer restraint, compelling proportion, strong originality.
Direction A: SPATIAL FRAME. Design a very open, airy capital D out of a few uniform slender-but-robust strokes, like an axonometric architectural frame for a digital canvas. Flat line drawing with spatial perspective, NOT a shaded 3D extrusion. A tall straight near edge and two receding connections resolve into an unmistakable D-shaped far arc. Intriguing negative space and controlled asymmetry. No solid filled D silhouette anywhere. Match with light, widely but naturally spaced contemporary architectural sans lettering; preserve the spatial D as the first glyph, at cap height. Aim for the sophistication of an architecture or design-culture identity. The mark should feel expansive, light and structurally exact.

concepts.title: Authorship, preserved
concepts.story: The person supplies the taste and intention; Desegnos gives those choices form. A custom editorial D treats the user's work as authored design, with the character of a publisher's signature rather than an interchangeable AI badge.

concepts.title: Two contributions, one creation
concepts.story: A person brings intent and the software brings execution. Two interlaced strokes become one D, showing a coordinated act of making while keeping the human contribution visible.

concepts.title: Intent sets the coordinates
concepts.story: In Desegnos, where you place a request is part of what you mean. A D defined by discrete points turns that distinctive interaction into an identity: individual decisions give a blank canvas its structure.
